title: Shipments Dashboard
subtitle: Manage and track all your agricultural trade shipments

empty.noDataHint: Get started by creating your first shipment to track and manage your agricultural trade.

createShipment.title: Create shipment agreement
createShipment.pageDescription: Fill in the details below to create your shipment agreement. It will be sent to the selected {{party}} for confirmation, then the smart contract is created so you can track the shipment.

steps.productSubBuy: What do you want to buy?
steps.productSubSell: What do you want to sell?
steps.summarySub: Review the form data and confirm the agreement
steps.supplierHint: If the supplier doesn't have an account yet, we'll send an invitation. Company details come from their profile or uploaded documents.
steps.documentsHint: If you already have invoices, bills of lading, or other trade PDFs, upload them here. We will classify them and fill in any missing details.
steps.summaryHint: After your confirmation, the smart contract will be created and you will be able to track/manage the shipment.

fields.quantityBuy: How many units are you buying?
fields.quantitySell: How many units are you selling?
fields.departureDate: What is the expected departure date?
fields.arrivalDate: What is the expected arrival date?

createShipment.activationNote: Shipment will be activated after double-sided supplier and buyer acceptance.
createShipment.smartContractNote: The smart contract will be created automatically and the data will be locked.

documents.hint: Optional: upload PDFs from an existing or completed shipment (commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, etc.). We classify them and pre-fill any empty fields in your agreement.
documents.dropOrClick: Drag & drop PDFs, or click to browse
documents.pdfOnly: PDF only, up to 30 MB each
documents.detectedNote: These values are applied to your agreement and saved on the shipment when you confirm.
documents.uploadAfterCreateWarn: Shipment was created but some documents could not be uploaded. You can add them from the shipment page.

modals.acceptAgreementDesc: To proceed with creating a smart contract for this shipment, approval from all participating parties is necessary.
modals.shipmentCreatedDesc: Smart contract has been created. Now you can track/manage your shipment.
modals.submitChangesSupplier: Supplier acceptance will be reset, he will receive a changes request via email.
modals.submitChangesBuyer: Buyer acceptance will be reset, he will receive a changes request via email.
modals.notifiedSupplier: Supplier has been notified via email that you are waiting for the acceptance.
modals.notifiedBuyer: Buyer has been notified via email that you are waiting for the acceptance.
modals.waitingOthers: You have accepted the agreement. To proceed to the next step, all other participants must also accept the agreement. Please wait for their confirmation.
modals.companyData: Provide your company data to continue

banner.label: Estimated recovery
banner.headline: Recover up to {{amount}} across {{count}} operations
banner.subtitle: Peru export drawback — recover up to 3% of FOB value paid in taxes (SUNAT).

summaryStrip.riskReasonRejected: Auto-rejected — document dates violate drawback chronology

panel.requirementsSubtitle: Upload phase 1–4 documents (imported input, procurement, processing, export). Fruit purchase invoice is optional.
panel.uploadNotAvailable: Upload is available when you are the supplier on the active milestone or have a payment in progress

rawMaterialTransportGuide.missing: Required to prove transport into plant

decision.accepted: Checks passed — pending admin verification of uploads
decision.rejected: Blocked — hard stop or chronology failure
decision.incomplete: Incomplete — upload or fix required documents

final.accepted: Accepted after admin verification of all required files
final.pending_admin: Pending final admin verification (all 10 required files)

rejection.missing_main_product_transport: No main-product transport guide dated while processing or export documents are already on file.
rejection.export_before_packaging: Export date is before packaging/processing — export must follow processing.
rejection.transport_after_packaging: Raw material transport is dated after packaging — transport to plant must come first.
rejection.purchase_after_later_stage: Purchase date is after transport, packaging, or export.
rejection.labels_transport_date_mismatch: Labels invoice date does not match labels transport guide date.
rejection.labels_quantity_mismatch: Labels invoice box count does not match labels transport guide box count.
rejection.labels_after_processing: Labels invoice date is after processing/maquila started.
